messages:
jasper: quick FYI — i'm prototyping a split-route for embeddings based on payload size (small vs large). idea: route tiny requests to low-latency fastpath, big batched ones to high-throughput pool. want input on quota signals + console UX.

sloane: how are we defining small vs large? bytes? vector count? dims?

kevin: telemetry suggests most failures on the big path are 413s caused by framing, not dims. we should surface a 'payload_bytes' bucket in the console first.

maria: agree. console proposal: show per-route cost (per-1k-embed-units), p50/p95 latency, and a pie of small/large split. also need an SLA estimator so product teams can see impact.

nate: watch out for mixed-dim requests. one request with mixed dims can be considered "large" even if bytes are small. we should prefer dims-over-bytes for routing when present.

jasper: valid. proposal: primary signal = max(dims, vector_count, bytes_threshold). fallback to bytes if dims missing. header suggestion: `X-Embed-Size-Bucket: small|large|mixed`. runtime will compute if header absent.

kevin: +1 for header. also add telemetry tag `ingest_size_bucket` so we can aggregate in grafana. sample query i used: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{ingest_size_bucket=\"large\"}[5m])) by (route)`.

maria: on console UX, we should add an estimated unit-cost column and a toggle to view only routes that exceed a cost threshold. Product managers will love quick filters.

nate: can the fastpath do partial batching? concern: small requests arriving concurrently might still be batched and increase latency spike. need a batching window knob.

jasper: yes — fastpath will support micro-batching with tight deadline (e.g., 5ms) and max batch size. large path uses larger batch windows. runtime config: `fastpath.batch_deadline_ms=5` and `throughput.batch_deadline_ms=50`.

ops-bot: [alert] embed-ingest-fastpath-error-rate crossed 3% in us-west-2 at 2026-02-14T18:03:12Z

kevin: ops-bot alert explains spike earlier. some clients send very large arrays without dims header, runtime misclassified => big request routed to fastpath and OOM.

jasper: action items: 1) add `X-Embed-Size-Bucket` header docs in API spec, 2) add `ingest_size_bucket` tag to telemetry (kevin), 3) console: add split-breakdown + per-route cost estimate (maria), 4) runtime: implement dims-first heuristic + safe-fallback to slowpath on OOM (nate).

maria: i'll prototype console mockups this week. will add a 'SLA impact' sparkline per route.

sloane: should we expose a client-side SDK helper that precomputes the header? might reduce misclassifications.

jasper: yes — sdk helper `computeEmbedBucket(payload)` in python/js. fallback server-side remains.

kevin: once telemetry is in, we'll run a 2-week canary to compare cost delta if we route 30% of borderline requests to throughput pool. info will feed into optimize recommendations.

nate: also log reasons for fallback (missing-dims, mixed-dims, oom, size-override) so we can instrument root cause.

jasper: agreed. final note: keep default behavior backward compatible — if header absent, best-effort classification but no hard failures. :thumbsup: 

(maria added a thread reaction :eyes:)
